subject: Request: connector freeze — ask for sandbox top-up & short runway
messages:
From: Sam Lee <sam@integron.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: claire@integron.ai
Date: 2027-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding update — connector freeze; asking for sandbox top-up

Hi Marissa / Markus,

Quick note from my side — we hit an unexpected blocker while wiring the Integron connector to your sandbox. The adapter we received late last week is failing with repeated timeouts; our infra team is stretched and will need a couple of sprints to get a patch in. That means our feature flag rollout and the POC demo with our product team (scheduled 6/22) are at risk.

We’ve consumed most of our allocated sandbox credits trying diffs and retries. Would Redwood consider a small top-up (USD-equivalent credits) and/or a short trial extension (7–10 days) so we can finish the last-mile testing? If helpful, I’ve attached the latest error log and a short note from our infra lead describing the failure pattern.

We’re committed to moving forward — this is a timing problem, not a fit issue. Appreciate any runway you can provide.

Attachments: integron_error_log.txt

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Lee
Head of Product
Integron, Inc.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam@integron.ai>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding update — connector freeze; asking for sandbox top-up

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. I’m sorry the adapter is blocking the demo.

We can absolutely help with a short runway so you can complete verification. Proposed short-term plan:
- Immediate: issue a one-time sandbox top-up (USD 2,500 equivalent) to cover retries + expanded test cases.
- Extension: 7-day trial extension tied to the top-up, to expire 2027-06-29.
- Condition: we’ll need a brief acceptance note from your infra lead confirming the issue is resolved (or a remediation timeline) before any additional extension.

I’ve looped in Markus to confirm approvals for the spend and for legal to sign the quick top-up form. Monica, can you follow up with Integron on a narrow set of tests we should prioritize?

I’ll prepare the approval form and share the DocuSign link if Markus signs off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks, that plan looks reasonable. Approve the one-time top-up and the 7-day extension subject to the following:

1) Finance cap: charge must not exceed the equivalent of USD 2,500 and must be recorded against deal D-INT-20270615-042.
2) Legal/Compliance: have Integron sign the short top-up amendment (I see the form attached) — Claudia in Legal should review any language that materially changes billing or data retention.
3) Product Ops: require a short post-mortem note from Integron’s infra lead after the patch (email OK) that summarizes root cause and steps taken.

Monica — please own the technical acceptance checklist and confirm the three smoke tests you’ll run. I’ll send the quick approval via DocuSign once Legal green-lights the form.

—Markus

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam@integron.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding update — connector freeze; asking for sandbox top-up

Hi Sam — I took a look at the attached error snippets. Quick notes and next steps:

- Observed symptom: repeated 502 timeouts from Integron’s adapter during the auth handshake; appears to be a keepalive/thread-starvation issue under parallel test load.
- Short checklist I’ll validate once you push the patch:
  1) Auth handshake succeeds for 100 consecutive requests at concurrency=10.
  2) KV cache warm-start verified (no cache misses after warm-up).
  3) End-to-end sample issuance + retrieval within 800ms p50.

Sam — can you drop the patched adapter (or a link to the image) and a short note from your infra lead confirming the changes? I’ll run the three smoke tests and reply with results within 24 hours.

Attachment: scope_of_work_v2.pdf (your infra note would be enough to trigger the tests)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 11:20 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marissa — thanks, that plan looks reasonable...
From: Sam Lee <sam@integron.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-17T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding update — connector freeze; asking for sandbox top-up

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround and for approving the provisional plan. Claire from infra and I pushed a patch earlier today and I’m attaching the short post describing the fix and an artifact link. Claire’s note: we increased the adapter worker pool + added a retry/backoff on auth transient failures; initial smoke runs look good.

I’ve also completed the top-up approval form and attached the signed PDF (topup_approval_form.pdf). If Legal needs anything else, ping me.

Appreciate the support — I’ll let Monica know when the adapter image is available for your smoke tests. We’re optimistic the demo on 6/22 stays on.

Best,
Sam
Sam Lee
Head of Product
Integron, Inc.

Attachments: topup_approval_form.pdf
